XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='IHC.ITF.DStruc.AllTracDelimited.Record.Record' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetDocType='SunquestMfnM02:MFN_M02' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>DTL for MSPR Provider HL7 to Sunquest</annotation> <trace value='"*************MSH******************"' /> <assign value='"SUNQUEST"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication}' action='set' /> <assign value='"ALLTRAC"' property='target.{MSH:SendingApplication}' action='set' /> <assign value='$zstrip($ZDATETIME($ZTIMESTAMP,3,1,4), "*P")' property='target.{MSH:MessageControlID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"MFN"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.messagetype}' action='set' /> <assign value='"02"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> <assign value='$Translate(..CurrentDateTime("%c(8,1,4)")," :.","")' property='target.{MSH:DateTimeOfMessage.timeofanevent}' action='set' /> <assign value='"2.3"' property='target.{MSH:VersionID.versionID}' action='set' /> <trace value='"*************MFI******************"' /> <assign value='"PRA"' property='target.{MFI:MasterFileIdentifier.identifier}' action='set' /> <trace value='"*************MFE******************"' /> <assign value='"MUP"' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).MFE:RecordLevelEventCode}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.ProviderId' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).MFE:PrimaryKeyValueMFE(1)}' action='set' /> <trace value='"*************STF******************"' /> <assign value='context.ProviderId' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:PrimaryKeyValueSTF.identifier}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.LastName' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:StaffName(1).familylastname.familyname}' action='set' /> <trace value='"*******last name: " _context.LastName' /> <assign value='context.FirstName' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:StaffName(1).givenname}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.MidName' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:StaffName(1).middleinitialorname}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.ContactStatus' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:ActiveInactiveFlag}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.PhoneFormatted '=""' > <true> <assign value='source.PhoneFormatted' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(1).phonenumber1}' action='set' /> <assign value='"PH"' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(1).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.SecPhoneFormatted '=""' > <true> <assign value='source.SecPhoneFormatted' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(2).phonenumber1}' action='set' /> <assign value='"PH"' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(2).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.FaxFormatted '=""' > <true> <assign value='source.FaxFormatted' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(3).phonenumber1}' action='set' /> <assign value='"FX"' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(3).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.MobileFormatted '=""' > <true> <assign value='source.MobileFormatted' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(4).phonenumber1}' action='set' /> <assign value='"CP"' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(4).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.BeeperPager '=""' > <true> <assign value='source.BeeperPager' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(5).phonenumber1}' action='set' /> <assign value='"BP"' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(5).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <trace value='"The Organization name needs to use abbreviation, remove '-', and limit to 35 charaters." ' /> <assign value='source.OrganizationName' property='organizatoinName' action='set' /> <assign value='..replace(..replace(source.OrganizationName,"-"," "),"Intermountain","Im")' property='organizationName' action='set' /> <trace value='"The organization name after tweak: " _organizatoinName' /> <assign value='..Length(organizatoinName)' property='orgLength' action='set' /> <trace value='"The string length of the organization name: " _orgLength' /> <if condition='orgLength > 35' > <true> <assign value='..SubString(organizatoinName,1,35)' property='orgName' action='set' /> <assign value='orgName' property='organizatoinName' action='set' /> <trace value='"The organization name after length sizing: " _organizatoinName' /> </true> </if> <assign value='organizatoinName' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:OfficeHomeAddress(1).streetaddress}' action='set' /> <trace value='"The organization name after mapping: " _organizatoinName' /> <trace value='"Physical Street needs to replace the whole string with hyphen if Timbuktu is found."' /> <trace value='"Also expand the single letter for direction in full and size the whole string to 35 characters."' /> <assign value='source.PhysicalStreet' property='streetName' action='set' /> <trace value='"****Physical Street :" _source.PhysicalStreet' /> <trace value='"*******Street Name: " _streetName' /> <if condition='..Contains("Timbuktu",streetName)' > <true> <assign value='"-"' property='streetName' action='set' /> <trace value='"Street Name: " _streetName' /> </true> <false> <assign value='..ReplaceStr(streetName," N. "," North ")' property='streetName' action='set' /> <assign value='..ReplaceStr(streetName," N "," North ")' property='streetName' action='set' /> <trace value='"Street Name after N expansion:" _streetName' /> <assign value='..ReplaceStr(streetName," S. "," South ")' property='streetName' action='set' /> <assign value='..ReplaceStr(streetName," S "," South ")' property='streetName' action='set' /> <assign value='..ReplaceStr(streetName," E. "," East ")' property='streetName' action='set' /> <assign value='..ReplaceStr(streetName," E "," East ")' property='streetName' action='set' /> <assign value='..ReplaceStr(streetName," W. "," West ")' property='streetName' action='set' /> <assign value='..ReplaceStr(streetName," W "," West ")' property='streetName' action='set' /> <trace value='"******* Street Name as W expansion: " _streetName' /> <assign value='..Length(streetName)' property='len' action='set' /> <trace value='"The string length of the street name: " _len' /> <if condition='len > 35' > <true> <assign value='..SubString(streetName,1,35)' property='strName' action='set' /> <assign value='strName' property='streetName' action='set' /> <trace value='"The street name after length sizing: " _streetName' /> </true> </if> </false> </if> <assign value='streetName' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:OfficeHomeAddress(1).otherdesignation}' action='set' /> <trace value='"Street Name to map: " _streetName' /> <assign value='context.City' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:OfficeHomeAddress(1).city}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.State' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:OfficeHomeAddress(1).stateorprovince}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.Zip ' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:OfficeHomeAddress(1).ziporpostalcode}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.CallBackComments' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).STF:Phone(6).anytext}' action='set' /> <trace value='"*************PRA******************"' /> <assign value='context.ProviderId' property='target.{MFEgrp(1).PRA:PrimaryKeyValuePRA.identifier}' action='set' /> </transform>
